validationNotes.resolvedAttempts: Initial failures were fixture issues: a sealed sole host leaves no legal Aura execution; native empty pendingEffects may be absent; the unrelated opponent attacker needed to be untapped; the correct registered GR-prohibition source is Aarlkaite dmex19-026. Corrected focused55 cases all pass. No production assertion failure remained.
coverage: All6 official print images fully reviewed. Strict raw-face pins preserve original IDs and Ranja print differences; corrected displayed Ranja text and end-of-current-turn power penalty follow official errata31435.
All three Auras paid from hand and attached to existing/new GR, both seats, exact power bonuses and powered breakers, saved/encrypted room round trips with all physical UIDs preserved.

Ranja own/other host counts, ignored attachments count physically, hostile targetability, no enemy, actual S-trigger kill, penalty expiration even after source departure. Actual Christmas GR may die before Ranja ability, which still uses last-known attached count.

Tentacol multiple copies and same-host-only attachment triggers, ignored Aura versus ignored host, sealed host exclusion and resolved boost lasting independently of source. Actual QA41289 Fire/Dark GR into original Zero Phoenix keeps two Tentacols without retriggering or spurious power.

Gappazeo actual attacking/defending victory, own versus unrelated/enemy wins, tie/loss/ignored source, multiple copies, empty GR/prohibition. Requested repetitions are not clamped to initial GR length: actual face-up Paranormal kills and returns the same GR on each of three successive summons.
Actual Aura Magnum does not punish native GR paid summons. Actual Slayer destroys the victorious host only after its GR ability resolves.
Related256 tests cover1352/1354/1362/1431/1434/1437/1452/1460/1723/1796/1807; online5 plus npm check passed. Full npm test and known long groups were not rerun.
